background: HSBC Bank plc is the non-ring-fenced UK bank of HSBC, housing the group's European corporate and investment banking, markets and private banking, funded by corporate and institutional deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the bank's ratings rest heavily on the support of its group. CET1 of 17.1% is in the top quarter of UK majors, but leverage of 4.1%, LCR of 139% and NSFR of 112% are all in the bottom quarter. Every ratio has fallen since 30 Jun 2025: CET1 by 2.3 points, leverage by 1.1 points, LCR by 15 points and NSFR by 5 points. The flagged news, the newest on 7 Oct 2026, is about planned job cuts in the UK wealth business, not credit.
